links.outcome: Currency of LLM information on emerging GLP1RA concerns
links.effect: LLM lacked updated information on newly emerging concerns such as fertility and mental health, reflecting static training data limitations.
links.quote: However, it lacked updated information pertaining to newly emerging concerns surrounding GLP1RA use, such as the impact on fertility and mental health.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and safety of LLM-generated responses (GPT-4o) versus Google search for patient-facing GLP-1 receptor agonist queries, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
